about.title: About IBNI
about.subtitle: Empowering learners by connecting them with the right educational resources and services.

who.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: IBNI is a digital platform designed to empower learners by connecting them with the right educational resources and services. Created by a team of service marketing and business students at the University of Tlemcen, IBNI bridges the gap between knowledge seekers and providers through innovation and accessibility.

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.body: Our mission is to make learning more accessible, personalized, and efficient by leveraging digital tools to support students, educators, and lifelong learners.

pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.body: We envision a future where every learner, regardless of background or location, has access to tailored educational content and services that support their personal and professional growth.

name.title: The Name IBNI
paragraphs: “IBNI” is an Arabic word meaning “build”. It reflects our belief that education is an act of construction: building future-ready learners, one connection at a time.
Crafting the leaders of tomorrow. Today.

story.title: The Idea Behind IBNI
paragraphs: IBNI was born from a final-year academic project at the University of Tlemcen, driven by the desire to solve real-world learning challenges. Inspired by personal experiences and market gaps, we transformed our idea into a growing digital initiative.

We noticed that students often struggled to find the right resources, tutors, and educational services that matched their specific needs. At the same time, qualified teachers and educational institutions lacked efficient ways to connect with potential students. IBNI was created to bridge this gap, providing a comprehensive platform where education seekers and providers could connect seamlessly.
